<!--
Organization on the script : 
Two kinds of chunks:
  - chunks tagged FIGURE: BODY produce a figure meant for the thesis body.
  - chunks tagged FIGURE: ANNEX produce a figure meant for the appendix
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4.5  # default (single-panel) size; overridden per chunk below
)
```

## 0. Packages, shared theme, figure-size classes

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(openxlsx)
library(infercnv)
library(future)
```

```{r theme-thesis}
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Shared theme for every figures
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
theme_thesis <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) %+replace%
    theme(
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      axis.line        = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      plot.title      = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = base_size,     color = "grey30"),
      axis.title      = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text       = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold")
    )
}

# Standard figure-size CLASSES (inches, at 300 dpi for ggsave). 
FIG_SINGLE  <- list(w = 5.5, h = 4.5)    # one panel (e.g. one UMAP, one bar chart)
FIG_DOUBLE  <- list(w = 9,   h = 4.5)    # two panels side by side
FIG_GRID2x2 <- list(w = 10,  h = 8)      # 2x2 grid (e.g. 4 resolutions/PC choices)
FIG_WIDE    <- list(w = 13,  h = 5)      # wide multi-panel row (e.g. 4-8 FeaturePlots)

save_thesis <- function(plot, filename, size = FIG_SINGLE, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(filename, plot, width = size$w, height = size$h, dpi = dpi)
}
```

## 1. Data import and Seurat object creation

```{r data-import}
# Path to 10x data
## Base directory
## Subfolders : Cell Ranger folders, Souporcell folders
data_dir       <- "Data"
cellranger_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "cellranger_outputs")
souporcell_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "souporcell_outputs")

gb_dir  <- file.path(cellranger_dir, "gbtx1_sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")  # tissue
pde_dir <- file.path(cellranger_dir, "gbtx2_sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix")  # PDE

gb_soup_file  <- file.path(souporcell_dir, "gbtx1_clusters.tsv")
pde_soup_file <- file.path(souporcell_dir, "gbtx2_clusters.tsv")

### Load the matrix Cell Ranger
gb_counts  <- Read10X(data.dir = gb_dir)
pde_counts <- Read10X(data.dir = pde_dir)
### Check les dimensions --> genes number, cells number
dim(gb_counts)
dim(pde_counts)

### Load the SouporCell
soup_gb  <- read.delim(gb_soup_file)
soup_pde <- read.delim(pde_soup_file)

# Create Seurat objects
# lignes = gènes, colonnes = cellules, valeurs = counts (nombre de reads / UMI)
# Seurat calcule for each cell : nFeature_RNA (genes), nCount_RNA (total de counts)
gb  <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = gb_counts,
  project = "GB_tissue",     # project's name
  min.cells = 3,             # un gène doit être exprimé dans min 3 cells
  min.features = 200         # cell doit avoir au moins 200 gènes détectés
)
pde <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = pde_counts,
  project = "PDE",
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200
)

# Add metadata, new columns in the Seurat matrix
# Metadata = informations sur les cellules, "une étiquette", exemple : condition, patient, clusters
# Add Condition metadata
gb$condition  <- "Tissue"
pde$condition <- "PDE"

# Add Souporcell metadata
## Match barcodes between Seurat and Souporcell outputs (identify the same cells in both datasets)
## assignment : attribute each cell to a genetic cluster (future patient identity, revealed with génotype)
## status : indicates whether the assignment is reliable
###singlet = one cell detected
###doublet = two cells captured together (will be removed)
gb$souporcell_cluster <- soup_gb$assignment[match(colnames(gb), soup_gb$barcode)]
gb$souporcell_status  <- soup_gb$status[match(colnames(gb), soup_gb$barcode)]
pde$souporcell_cluster <- soup_pde$assignment[match(colnames(pde), soup_pde$barcode)]
pde$souporcell_status  <- soup_pde$status[match(colnames(pde), soup_pde$barcode)]

head(gb@meta.data)  # to look at the metadata of my seurat object, to check if it works
table(gb$souporcell_status, useNA = "ifany")   # to check singlet/doublets
table(gb$souporcell_cluster, useNA = "ifany")  # to check cells per patients
table(pde$souporcell_status, useNA = "ifany")
table(pde$souporcell_cluster, useNA = "ifany")
# useNA = "ifany" is to see if something gets wrong or not assigned, it will be written NA
# Option          Signification :
## "no"     ne jamais montrer les NA
## "ifany"  montrer seulement s'il y en a
## "always" toujours afficher NA
```

## 2. QC

```{r qc-singlets}
# Keep only the status = singlets (for the Souporcell metadata)
# (les sankey plots de la répartition singlet/doublet ont été faits avec sankeymatic.com)
gb_singlet  <- subset(gb,  subset = souporcell_status == "singlet")
pde_singlet <- subset(pde, subset = souporcell_status == "singlet")

# QC = removing unwanted cells from the dataset
# To add a column named percent.mt and calculer % de gènes mitochondriaux par cellule
# PercentageFeatureSet = counts mitochondriaux / counts totaux cellule x 100
gb_singlet  <- PercentageFeatureSet(gb_singlet,  col.name = "percent.mt", assay = "RNA", pattern = "^MT-")
pde_singlet <- PercentageFeatureSet(pde_singlet, col.name = "percent.mt", assay = "RNA", pattern = "^MT-")
```

```{r qc-before-violin, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
# FIGURE: ANNEX -- QC metrics before filtering
# Plot QC metrics as a violin plot
v_gb_before <- VlnPlot(gb_singlet, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                       ncol = 3,            # number of columns
                       log = TRUE,          # Y en échelle logarithmique, change juste l'affichage
                       assay = "RNA",
                       layer = "counts",    # to have the raw data (différents layers dans un assay)
                       pt.size = 0.1) &     # taille des dots, pour pas que ce soit trop gros
  theme_thesis() & NoLegend() & plot_annotation(title = "GB tissue: before QC filtration")
v_gb_before
save_thesis(v_gb_before, "qc_before_violin_tissue.png", FIG_DOUBLE)

v_pde_before <- VlnPlot(pde_singlet, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                        ncol = 3, log = TRUE, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts", pt.size = 0.1) &
  theme_thesis() & NoLegend() & plot_annotation(title = "PDE: before QC filtration")
v_pde_before
save_thesis(v_pde_before, "qc_before_violin_pde.png", FIG_DOUBLE)
```

```{r qc-before-scatter, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
# FIGURE: ANNEX -- nCount vs percent.mt and nCount vs nFeature, before filtering
## Scatter plot
# FeatureScatter is typically used to visualize feature-feature relationships
p1 <- FeatureScatter(gb_singlet, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1e5), ylim = c(0, 100)) + theme_thesis()
p2 <- FeatureScatter(gb_singlet, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1e5), ylim = c(0, 1e4)) + theme_thesis()
p3 <- FeatureScatter(pde_singlet, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1e5), ylim = c(0, 100)) + theme_thesis()
p4 <- FeatureScatter(pde_singlet, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1e5), ylim = c(0, 1e4)) + theme_thesis()

scatter_before <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) + plot_annotation(title = "Before QC filtration (top: tissue, bottom: PDE)")
scatter_before
save_thesis(scatter_before, "qc_before_scatter.png", FIG_GRID2x2)
```

```{r qc-apply}
# Apply QC ; seuils adaptés du papier de Jacob et al.
qcthr <- c(
  maxMT = 15,     # mitochondrial reads
  minG  = 800,    # min genes par cellule (nFeature_RNA)
  maxG  = 10000   # max genes par cellule (nFeature_RNA)
)

cells_gb  <- gb_singlet$percent.mt  < qcthr["maxMT"] & gb_singlet$nFeature_RNA  > qcthr["minG"] & gb_singlet$nFeature_RNA  < qcthr["maxG"]
cells_pde <- pde_singlet$percent.mt < qcthr["maxMT"] & pde_singlet$nFeature_RNA > qcthr["minG"] & pde_singlet$nFeature_RNA < qcthr["maxG"]

gb_qc  <- subset(gb_singlet,  cells = colnames(gb_singlet)[cells_gb])
pde_qc <- subset(pde_singlet, cells = colnames(pde_singlet)[cells_pde])

# look at how many cells we remove (cells kept: tissue = ncol(gb_qc)/ncol(gb_singlet), PDE = ncol(pde_qc)/ncol(pde_singlet))
c(tissue_before = ncol(gb_singlet), tissue_after = ncol(gb_qc),
  pde_before = ncol(pde_singlet), pde_after = ncol(pde_qc))
```

```{r qc-after-violin, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
# FIGURE: ANNEX -- QC metrics after filtering
# look again at the plots after the QC
v_gb_after <- VlnPlot(gb_qc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                      ncol = 3, log = TRUE, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts") &
  theme_thesis() & NoLegend() & plot_annotation(title = "GB tissue: after QC filtration")
v_gb_after
save_thesis(v_gb_after, "qc_after_violin_tissue.png", FIG_DOUBLE)

v_pde_after <- VlnPlot(pde_qc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                       ncol = 3, log = TRUE, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts") &
  theme_thesis() & NoLegend() & plot_annotation(title = "PDE: after QC filtration")
v_pde_after
save_thesis(v_pde_after, "qc_after_violin_pde.png", FIG_DOUBLE)
```

## 3. Full-cohort integration (all 4 genetic clusters per pool)

This step exists only to obtain a broad cell-type annotation
(`manual_annotation_broad`) used later as the *reference* (non-malignant)
cells for inferCNV -- myeloid, endothelial and stromal/perivascular cells,
identifiable regardless of which patient they came from. It is not itself a
thesis figure.

```{r integration-sctransform}
set.seed(1)
# INTEGRATION step 1) Prepare object for Seurat v5 integration
# Merge Tissue and PDE in a new object for integration
gb_pde_integrated <- merge(gb_qc, y = pde_qc, add.cell.ids = c("Tissue", "PDE"),
                           project = "GB_Tissue_PDE_integrated")
# Check that both conditions are present
table(gb_pde_integrated$condition)

# INTEGRATION step 3) SCTransform before integration
# Use SCTransform : parce que ça gère mieux les différences techniques, stabilise la variance,
# fonctionne très bien pour des datasets hétérogènes, et est très utilisé maintenant
gb_pde_integrated <- SCTransform(gb_pde_integrated, assay = "RNA", vars.to.regress = "percent.mt",
                                  variable.features.n = 3000, verbose = FALSE, seed.use = 1)

# "Pour les prochaines étapes, utilise les données normalisées SCT, pas les données RNA brutes."
DefaultAssay(gb_pde_integrated) <- "SCT"

# INTEGRATION step 4 - PCA before integration
# PCA = Principal Component Analysis -- choose number of PCA
gb_pde_integrated <- RunPCA(gb_pde_integrated, verbose = FALSE)

# problème d'espace... qui bloque quand les exports sont trop gros, donc on change cette limite
# Increase memory limit for future
options(future.globals.maxSize = 4 * 1024^3)
# Optional: run sequentially to avoid parallel export issues
plan("sequential")
```

```{r integration-rpca}
# INTEGRATION step 5 - Integrate Tissue and PDE using RPCA
## Anchor-based RPCA integration : représente une méthode plus rapide et plus conservative
## (moins de correction) pour l'intégration.
gb_pde_integrated <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = gb_pde_integrated, method = RPCAIntegration, normalization.method = "SCT",
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:12, verbose = FALSE
)

gb_pde_integrated <- RunUMAP(gb_pde_integrated, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:12,
                              reduction.name = "umap.integrated")
gb_pde_integrated <- FindNeighbors(gb_pde_integrated, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:12)
gb_pde_integrated <- FindClusters(gb_pde_integrated, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

gb_pde_integrated$integrated_clusters <- gb_pde_integrated$SCT_snn_res.0.5
Idents(gb_pde_integrated) <- "integrated_clusters"
```

```{r integration-annotate-broad}
# Broad annotation, used ONLY to flag non-malignant reference cells for
# inferCNV below. Cluster identities were determined by inspecting canonical
# markers per cluster (cycling/tumor-neural/immune/endothelial/oligo/
# astro/progenitor marker panels -- not reproduced here, see methods).
cluster_annotations_broad <- c(
  "0" = "OPC-like cells", "1" = "Astrocyte-like cells", "2" = "Cycling cells",
  "3" = "Inflammatory myeloid cells", "4" = "Oligodendrocyte-like cells",
  "5" = "Cycling cells", "6" = "Cycling cells", "7" = "Stromal / Perivascular cells",
  "8" = "Neuronal-like cells", "9" = "Endothelial cells"
)

gb_pde_integrated$manual_annotation_broad <- unname(
  cluster_annotations_broad[as.character(gb_pde_integrated$integrated_clusters)]
)

gb_obj  <- subset(gb_pde_integrated, subset = condition == "Tissue")
pde_obj <- subset(gb_pde_integrated, subset = condition == "PDE")

table(gb_obj$souporcell_cluster, gb_obj$manual_annotation_broad)
table(pde_obj$souporcell_cluster, pde_obj$manual_annotation_broad)
```

## 4. inferCNV -- gene position file (one-time step)

```{r gene-order-file, eval=FALSE}
# Run once; reused for every inferCNV call below. Requires the GENCODE v50
# GTF (GRCh38/hg38) downloaded from https://www.gencodegenes.org/human/.
if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("data.table")
library(data.table)

gtf_file <- "gencode.v50.annotation.gtf"
gene_order_output_file <- "gencode_v50_gene_pos.txt"

gtf <- fread(gtf_file, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", quote = "", skip = "chr",
             col.names = c("chr", "source", "feature", "start", "end", "score", "strand", "frame", "attributes"))

genes <- gtf[feature == "gene"]
genes[, gene_name := sub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*', "\\1", attributes)]
gene_order <- genes[, .(gene_name, chr, start, end)]
gene_order <- gene_order[!duplicated(gene_name)]

main_chromosomes <- c(paste0("chr", 1:22), "chrX", "chrY", "chrM")
gene_order[, chr := factor(chr, levels = main_chromosomes)]
gene_order <- gene_order[!is.na(chr)]
gene_order <- gene_order[order(chr, start)]
gene_order[, chr := as.character(chr)]

fwrite(gene_order, gene_order_output_file, sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE)
```

```{r gene-order-load}
gene_order_file <- "gencode_v50_gene_pos.txt"
gene_order <- read.delim(gene_order_file, header = FALSE, col.names = c("gene", "chr", "start", "end"))
rownames(gene_order) <- gene_order$gene
```

## 5. Shared, gene-verified myeloid reference for inferCNV

A first inferCNV pass (endothelial + stromal + myeloid reference cells,
taken from the broad cluster-level annotation above) confirmed the HGG vs
LGG split, but PDE had too few of its own reference cells for a clean
per-pool comparison. To fix that, reference cells are instead selected
directly by canonical myeloid marker expression, pooled across BOTH tissue
and PDE, and sanity-checked against a mesenchymal-like signature to exclude
any malignant contamination.

```{r myeloid-reference}
myeloid_markers  <- c("AIF1", "CD163", "LYZ", "C1QA", "C1QB", "TYROBP", "FCGR3A")
mes_like_markers <- c("VEGFA", "HILPDA", "CA9", "ADM", "COL1A2", "COL4A1", "BGN")

# Score on normalized RNA counts, not the current default assay (SCT, left
# over from Section 3). SCT stores variance-stabilized Pearson residuals
gb_obj  <- NormalizeData(gb_obj,  assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)
pde_obj <- NormalizeData(pde_obj, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)

gb_obj  <- AddModuleScore(gb_obj,  features = list(myeloid_markers), name = "myeloid_score",    assay = "RNA")
pde_obj <- AddModuleScore(pde_obj, features = list(myeloid_markers), name = "myeloid_score",    assay = "RNA")
gb_obj  <- AddModuleScore(gb_obj,  features = list(mes_like_markers), name = "mes_check_score", assay = "RNA")
pde_obj <- AddModuleScore(pde_obj, features = list(mes_like_markers), name = "mes_check_score", assay = "RNA")

# Candidate reference cells: myeloid_score1 > 0.5, then drop any with a
# positive MES-like score (likely malignant contamination).
gb_myeloid_ref_cells_clean  <- colnames(gb_obj)[gb_obj$myeloid_score1 > 0.5 & gb_obj$mes_check_score1 <= 0]
pde_myeloid_ref_cells_clean <- colnames(pde_obj)[pde_obj$myeloid_score1 > 0.5]

shared_myeloid_reference_clean <- c(gb_myeloid_ref_cells_clean, pde_myeloid_ref_cells_clean)
length(shared_myeloid_reference_clean)  # total reference cells (tissue + PDE)
length(gb_myeloid_ref_cells_clean)      # tissue-side count
length(pde_myeloid_ref_cells_clean)     # PDE-side count

```

```{r combined-object-for-reference}
DefaultAssay(gb_obj)  <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(pde_obj) <- "RNA"

gb_diet  <- DietSeurat(gb_obj,  assays = "RNA", layers = "counts")
pde_diet <- DietSeurat(pde_obj, assays = "RNA", layers = "counts")

combined_for_ref <- merge(gb_diet, y = pde_diet, project = "combined_for_shared_reference")
combined_for_ref <- JoinLayers(combined_for_ref)
stopifnot(sum(duplicated(colnames(combined_for_ref))) == 0)
```

## 6. inferCNV per genetic cluster (shared myeloid reference)

```{r infercnv-runner}
run_infercnv_shared_reference <- function(seurat_obj, combined_obj, pool_label,
                                           cluster_col = "souporcell_cluster",
                                           fixed_ref_cells, gene_order_file,
                                           out_dir_base = "infercnv_by_genetic_cluster_v2",
                                           min_ref_cells = 30, n_threads = 4, clusters_subset = NULL) {

  dir.create(out_dir_base, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  stopifnot(cluster_col %in% colnames(meta))

  clusters <- sort(unique(na.omit(meta[[cluster_col]])))
  if (!is.null(clusters_subset)) clusters <- clusters[clusters %in% clusters_subset]

  ref_cells <- fixed_ref_cells
  if (length(ref_cells) < min_ref_cells) stop("Shared reference has fewer than min_ref_cells -- check filtering.")

  results <- list()
  for (cl in clusters) {
    cells_this_cluster <- rownames(meta)[meta[[cluster_col]] == cl]
    n_cells <- length(cells_this_cluster)
    message(sprintf("[%s] cluster %s: %d cells", pool_label, cl, n_cells))
    if (n_cells < 50) warning(sprintf("[%s] cluster %s: only %d cells (<50)", pool_label, cl, n_cells))

    test_cells <- setdiff(cells_this_cluster, ref_cells)
    obj_sub <- subset(combined_obj, cells = c(test_cells, ref_cells))
    obj_sub <- tryCatch(JoinLayers(obj_sub), error = function(e) obj_sub)
    counts  <- GetAssayData(obj_sub, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

    annot <- data.frame(
      group = ifelse(colnames(obj_sub) %in% ref_cells, "reference", paste0(pool_label, "_cluster", cl)),
      row.names = colnames(obj_sub)
    )
    annot_file <- file.path(out_dir_base, sprintf("annot_%s_cluster%s.txt", pool_label, cl))
    write.table(annot, annot_file, sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

    out_dir <- file.path(out_dir_base, sprintf("%s_cluster%s", pool_label, cl))
    dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    infercnv_obj <- CreateInfercnvObject(raw_counts_matrix = counts, annotations_file = annot_file,
                                          gene_order_file = gene_order_file, ref_group_names = "reference")
    infercnv_obj <- infercnv::run(infercnv_obj, cutoff = 0.1, out_dir = out_dir, cluster_by_groups = TRUE,
                                   denoise = TRUE, HMM = FALSE, num_threads = n_threads)

    results[[as.character(cl)]] <- list(n_cells = n_cells, out_dir = out_dir, status = "done")
    rm(obj_sub, counts, infercnv_obj, annot)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }
  results
}

# Reads one cluster's inferCNV result and returns a chr7-vs-chr10 score
# (per cell and averaged) plus the per-gene mean profile ("fingerprint").
read_infercnv_chr_profile <- function(out_dir) {
  obj_file <- file.path(out_dir, "run.final.infercnv_obj")
  if (!file.exists(obj_file)) { warning(sprintf("Can't find %s", obj_file)); return(NULL) }
  infercnv_obj <- readRDS(obj_file)

  full_mat <- infercnv_obj@expr.data
  obs_idx  <- unlist(infercnv_obj@observation_grouped_cell_indices)
  obs      <- full_mat[, obs_idx, drop = FALSE]

  common_genes <- intersect(rownames(obs), rownames(gene_order))
  obs   <- obs[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  chrom <- gene_order[common_genes, "chr"]
  chr7_genes  <- common_genes[chrom %in% c("chr7", "7")]
  chr10_genes <- common_genes[chrom %in% c("chr10", "10")]

  score_per_cell <- colMeans(obs[chr7_genes, , drop = FALSE]) - colMeans(obs[chr10_genes, , drop = FALSE])

  list(mean_gene_profile = rowMeans(obs), score_chr7_minus_chr10 = mean(score_per_cell),
       score_chr7_minus_chr10_per_cell = score_per_cell, n_cells = ncol(obs))
}

collect_chr_profiles <- function(res) {
  profiles <- list()
  for (cl in names(res)) {
    if (!identical(res[[cl]]$status, "done")) next
    profiles[[cl]] <- read_infercnv_chr_profile(res[[cl]]$out_dir)
  }
  profiles
}
```

```{r infercnv-run, eval=FALSE}
# Runs all 4 genetic clusters per pool (not just the HGG candidates) so the
# HGG/LGG split itself is re-confirmed under the cleaner shared reference.

res_gb_v2 <- run_infercnv_shared_reference(
  seurat_obj = gb_diet, combined_obj = combined_for_ref, pool_label = "GB",
  fixed_ref_cells = shared_myeloid_reference_clean, gene_order_file = gene_order_file, n_threads = 1
)
res_pde_v2 <- run_infercnv_shared_reference(
  seurat_obj = pde_diet, combined_obj = combined_for_ref, pool_label = "PDE",
  fixed_ref_cells = shared_myeloid_reference_clean, gene_order_file = gene_order_file, n_threads = 1
)

# Tag both result objects with the reference cell set that produced them.

attr(res_gb_v2,  "ref_cells_used") <- shared_myeloid_reference_clean
attr(res_pde_v2, "ref_cells_used") <- shared_myeloid_reference_clean

saveRDS(res_gb_v2,  "res_gb_v2.rds")
saveRDS(res_pde_v2, "res_pde_v2.rds")
```

```{r infercnv-load-results}

is_stale <- function(obj) {
  ref <- attr(obj, "ref_cells_used")
  is.null(ref) || !identical(sort(ref), sort(shared_myeloid_reference_clean))
}

if (!exists("res_gb_v2") || is_stale(res_gb_v2)) {
  if (!file.exists("res_gb_v2.rds")) {
    stop(
      "res_gb_v2 is missing or stale (reference set = ",
      length(shared_myeloid_reference_clean), " cells) and no res_gb_v2.rds ",
      "was found on disk either. Run the 'infercnv-run' chunk interactively ",
      "once (it is eval=FALSE, several minutes per cluster)."
    )
  }
  res_gb_v2 <- readRDS("res_gb_v2.rds")
  if (is_stale(res_gb_v2)) {
    stop(
      "STALE CACHE: res_gb_v2.rds on disk was computed with a different ",
      "reference cell set than the one currently in this session (",
      length(shared_myeloid_reference_clean), " cells). Delete res_gb_v2.rds ",
      "and re-run the 'infercnv-run' chunk interactively once."
    )
  }
}

if (!exists("res_pde_v2") || is_stale(res_pde_v2)) {
  if (!file.exists("res_pde_v2.rds")) {
    stop(
      "res_pde_v2 is missing or stale (reference set = ",
      length(shared_myeloid_reference_clean), " cells) and no res_pde_v2.rds ",
      "was found on disk either. Run the 'infercnv-run' chunk interactively ",
      "once (it is eval=FALSE, several minutes per cluster)."
    )
  }
  res_pde_v2 <- readRDS("res_pde_v2.rds")
  if (is_stale(res_pde_v2)) {
    stop(
      "STALE CACHE: res_pde_v2.rds on disk was computed with a different ",
      "reference cell set than the one currently in this session (",
      length(shared_myeloid_reference_clean), " cells). Delete res_pde_v2.rds ",
      "and re-run the 'infercnv-run' chunk interactively once."
    )
  }
}
```

```{r infercnv-pairing}
# HGG clusters confirmed by the score table above : tissue = clusters 0 & 1;
# PDE = clusters 0, 2 & 3 (all three turn out to be the same patient)
hgg_clusters_gb_v2  <- c("0", "1")
hgg_clusters_pde_v2 <- c("0", "2", "3")

pairing_v2 <- expand.grid(gb_cluster = hgg_clusters_gb_v2, pde_cluster = hgg_clusters_pde_v2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pairing_v2$correlation <- mapply(function(cl_gb, cl_pde) {
  g1 <- profiles_gb_v2[[cl_gb]]$mean_gene_profile
  g2 <- profiles_pde_v2[[cl_pde]]$mean_gene_profile
  common <- intersect(names(g1), names(g2))
  cor(g1[common], g2[common], method = "pearson")
}, pairing_v2$gb_cluster, pairing_v2$pde_cluster)

pde_pairs_v2 <- combn(hgg_clusters_pde_v2, 2, simplify = FALSE)
pde_internal_cor_v2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pde_pairs_v2, function(pair) {
  g1 <- profiles_pde_v2[[pair[1]]]$mean_gene_profile
  g2 <- profiles_pde_v2[[pair[2]]]$mean_gene_profile
  common <- intersect(names(g1), names(g2))
  data.frame(cluster_A = pair[1], cluster_B = pair[2], correlation = cor(g1[common], g2[common], method = "pearson"))
}))
pde_internal_full <- rbind(
  pde_internal_cor_v2,
  data.frame(cluster_A = pde_internal_cor_v2$cluster_B, cluster_B = pde_internal_cor_v2$cluster_A, correlation = pde_internal_cor_v2$correlation),
  data.frame(cluster_A = hgg_clusters_pde_v2, cluster_B = hgg_clusters_pde_v2, correlation = 1)
)
```

```{r hgg-pc-resolution-testing, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
# FIGURE: ANNEX -- PC-count sensitivity check (resolution fixed at 0.5,
# varying only the number of PCs, one variable at a time).
plan("sequential")
dims_to_test   <- c(8, 10, 12, 15, 20)
umap_plots     <- list()
cluster_counts <- c()

for (n in dims_to_test) {
  reduction_name <- paste0("integrated.rpca.", n)
  umap_name      <- paste0("umap.", n)
  cluster_col    <- paste0("clusters_pc", n)

  gb_pde_hgg <- IntegrateLayers(gb_pde_hgg, method = RPCAIntegration, normalization.method = "SCT",
                                 orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = reduction_name, dims = 1:n, verbose = FALSE)
  gb_pde_hgg <- RunUMAP(gb_pde_hgg, reduction = reduction_name, dims = 1:n, reduction.name = umap_name, verbose = FALSE)
  gb_pde_hgg <- FindNeighbors(gb_pde_hgg, reduction = reduction_name, dims = 1:n, verbose = FALSE)
  gb_pde_hgg <- FindClusters(gb_pde_hgg, resolution = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)

  gb_pde_hgg[[cluster_col]] <- gb_pde_hgg$seurat_clusters
  cluster_counts[as.character(n)] <- length(unique(gb_pde_hgg[[cluster_col]][, 1]))

  umap_plots[[as.character(n)]] <- DimPlot(gb_pde_hgg, reduction = umap_name, group.by = cluster_col, label = TRUE) +
    ggtitle(paste0(n, " PCs (", cluster_counts[as.character(n)], " clusters)")) +
    theme_thesis() + theme(legend.position = "none")
}
cluster_counts

p_pc_test <- wrap_plots(umap_plots, ncol = 3) & theme_thesis()
p_pc_test
save_thesis(p_pc_test, "hgg_pc_testing_grid.png", FIG_GRID2x2)
```

```{r hgg-marker-heatmap-helper}
# Reusable helper: marker heatmap for any "clusters_pcN" / "SCT_snn_res.X"
# column, used below to compare candidate clusterings.
check_marker_heatmap <- function(seurat_obj, cluster_col, n_top = 5, n_cells_per_cluster = 100) {
  Idents(seurat_obj) <- cluster_col
  markers <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_obj, only.pos = TRUE, logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.25)


  if (nrow(markers) == 0 || !"cluster" %in% colnames(markers)) {
    warning("check_marker_heatmap(): no markers passed the thresholds for '",
            cluster_col, "' -- skipping this heatmap (likely two very similar ",
            "clusters at this resolution). Not necessarily a problem, but worth ",
            "noting if this clustering is a serious candidate.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  top_markers <- markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = n_top) %>% ungroup()
  genes_use <- top_markers$gene[top_markers$gene %in% rownames(seurat_obj[["SCT"]]$scale.data)]
  if (length(genes_use) == 0) {
    warning("check_marker_heatmap(): none of the top markers for '", cluster_col,
            "' are in the SCT scale.data -- skipping this heatmap.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  cells_use <- unlist(lapply(levels(Idents(seurat_obj)), function(cl) {
    cells <- WhichCells(seurat_obj, idents = cl)
    sample(cells, min(length(cells), n_cells_per_cluster))
  }))
  DoHeatmap(subset(seurat_obj, cells = cells_use), features = genes_use, assay = "SCT", raster = FALSE) +
    NoLegend() + ggtitle(paste0("Markers: ", cluster_col)) + theme_thesis()
}

# Join layers before marker analysis
## pour rejoindre ce qui a été gardé en plusieurs layers pendant l'intégration (counts.Tissue et counts.PDE)
gb_pde_hgg <- JoinLayers(gb_pde_hgg, assay = "RNA")
DefaultAssay(gb_pde_hgg) <- "SCT"
gb_pde_hgg <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(gb_pde_hgg)
```

```{r malignancy-table}
# FIGURE: BODY (table) -- Wilcoxon test vs. the confirmed non-malignant
# baseline (clusters 8 & 9: myeloid + oligodendrocyte)
baseline_clusters  <- c("8", "9")
baseline_scores_v2 <- na.omit(gb_pde_hgg$cnv_score_chr7_chr10_v2[gb_pde_hgg$hgg_clusters %in% baseline_clusters])

malignancy_summary_v2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(gb_pde_hgg$hgg_clusters), function(cl) {
  cluster_scores <- na.omit(gb_pde_hgg$cnv_score_chr7_chr10_v2[gb_pde_hgg$hgg_clusters == cl])
  if (length(cluster_scores) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(cluster = cl, n_cells_scored = length(cluster_scores), median_score = NA,
                       median_baseline = median(baseline_scores_v2), p_value = NA, likely_malignant = NA))
  }
  test <- wilcox.test(cluster_scores, baseline_scores_v2, alternative = "greater")
  data.frame(cluster = cl, n_cells_scored = length(cluster_scores), median_score = median(cluster_scores),
             median_baseline = median(baseline_scores_v2), p_value = test$p.value, likely_malignant = test$p.value < 0.05)
}))
malignancy_summary_v2
```

## 11. Neftel / Nomura cell-state scoring of the cycling clusters

Gene signatures below are taken verbatim from the published supplementary
tables (Neftel et al. 2019, Cell, Table S2; Nomura et al. 2025, Nat Genet,
Supplementary Table 2) -- nothing invented or guessed.

```{r cycling-cluster-scoring}
# STEP 1-2: identity module scores (Neftel's 4 non-cycling states, Nomura's
# 7 non-cycling states). Never score "cycling" itself here -- that would be
# circular, given we're trying to explain what the cycling clusters ARE.
#
# Score on normalized RNA (not the current default assay, SCT, left over
# from the marker-heatmap step above) for the same reason as Section 5: SCT
# Pearson residuals can produce too many tied values for AddModuleScore's
# internal 24-bin control-gene matching on a marker panel this size.
gb_pde_hgg <- NormalizeData(gb_pde_hgg, assay = "RNA", verbose = FALSE)

gb_pde_hgg <- AddModuleScore(
  gb_pde_hgg,
  features = list(neftel_mes1, neftel_mes2, neftel_ac, neftel_opc, neftel_npc1, neftel_npc2),
  name = c("Neftel_MES1", "Neftel_MES2", "Neftel_AC", "Neftel_OPC", "Neftel_NPC1", "Neftel_NPC2"),
  assay = "RNA"
)
gb_pde_hgg <- AddModuleScore(
  gb_pde_hgg,
  features = list(nomura_identity_signatures$OPC, nomura_identity_signatures$AC, nomura_identity_signatures$MES,
                   nomura_identity_signatures$NPC, nomura_identity_signatures$Hypoxia, nomura_identity_signatures$GPC,
                   nomura_identity_signatures$Cilia),
  name = c("Nomura_OPC", "Nomura_AC", "Nomura_MES", "Nomura_NPC", "Nomura_Hypoxia", "Nomura_GPC", "Nomura_Cilia"),
  assay = "RNA"
)
gb_pde_hgg <- AddModuleScore(
  gb_pde_hgg, features = list(c(nomura_mp9_exn, nomura_mp14_nrgn), c(nomura_mp10_stress1, nomura_mp15_stress2)),
  name = c("Nomura_NEU", "Nomura_Stress"), assay = "RNA"
)

# Seurat appends its own counter to each name above (e.g. our "Neftel_MES1"
# -> column "Neftel_MES11"); map explicitly rather than guess with regex.
label_map <- c(
  "Neftel_MES11" = "MES1", "Neftel_MES22" = "MES2", "Neftel_AC3" = "AC", "Neftel_OPC4" = "OPC",
  "Neftel_NPC15" = "NPC1", "Neftel_NPC26" = "NPC2", "Nomura_OPC1" = "OPC", "Nomura_AC2" = "AC",
  "Nomura_MES3" = "MES", "Nomura_NPC4" = "NPC", "Nomura_Hypoxia5" = "Hypoxia", "Nomura_GPC6" = "GPC",
  "Nomura_Cilia7" = "Cilia", "Nomura_NEU1" = "NEU", "Nomura_Stress2" = "Stress"
)

cycling_cells <- subset(gb_pde_hgg, subset = hgg_clusters %in% c("2", "4", "5"))
meta <- cycling_cells@meta.data
```

```{r cycling-cluster-heatmap, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.5}
# FIGURE: ANNEX -- mean identity score per cycling cluster
score_summary <- meta %>% group_by(hgg_clusters) %>% summarise(across(all_of(names(label_map)), mean), .groups = "drop")
write.csv(score_summary, "cycling_clusters_identity_scores_FULL.csv", row.names = FALSE)

score_long <- score_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(-hgg_clusters, names_to = "raw_col", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(source = ifelse(grepl("^Neftel", raw_col), "Neftel 2019", "Nomura 2025"), signature = label_map[raw_col])

state_order <- c("MES1", "MES2", "MES", "AC", "OPC", "NPC1", "NPC2", "NPC", "GPC", "NEU", "Hypoxia", "Cilia", "Stress")
score_long$signature <- factor(score_long$signature, levels = state_order[state_order %in% unique(score_long$signature)])

p_cycling_heatmap <- ggplot(score_long, aes(x = signature, y = hgg_clusters, fill = score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2a78d6", mid = "#f0efec", high = "#e34948", midpoint = 0, name = "Mean score") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(score, 2)), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(~ source, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Identity scores of the cycling clusters (2, 4, 5)", x = NULL, y = "Cluster") +
  theme_thesis() + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
p_cycling_heatmap
save_thesis(p_cycling_heatmap, "cycling_clusters_identity_heatmap.png", FIG_DOUBLE)
```

```{r cycling-cluster-percell, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
# FIGURE: ANNEX -- per-cell classification (whichever score wins for that
# cell), % of cells per identity per cluster.
meta$Neftel_MES_max <- pmax(meta$Neftel_MES11, meta$Neftel_MES22)
meta$Neftel_NPC_max <- pmax(meta$Neftel_NPC15, meta$Neftel_NPC26)
neftel_matrix <- as.matrix(meta[, c("Neftel_MES_max", "Neftel_AC3", "Neftel_OPC4", "Neftel_NPC_max")])
colnames(neftel_matrix) <- c("MES", "AC", "OPC", "NPC")
neftel_max <- apply(neftel_matrix, 1, max)
meta$Neftel_call <- ifelse(neftel_max > 0, colnames(neftel_matrix)[max.col(neftel_matrix, ties.method = "first")], "Unresolved")

nomura_matrix <- as.matrix(meta[, c("Nomura_MES3", "Nomura_AC2", "Nomura_OPC1", "Nomura_NPC4", "Nomura_GPC6",
                                     "Nomura_NEU1", "Nomura_Hypoxia5", "Nomura_Cilia7", "Nomura_Stress2")])
colnames(nomura_matrix) <- c("MES", "AC", "OPC", "NPC", "GPC", "NEU", "Hypoxia", "Cilia", "Stress")
nomura_max <- apply(nomura_matrix, 1, max)
meta$Nomura_call <- ifelse(nomura_max > 0, colnames(nomura_matrix)[max.col(nomura_matrix, ties.method = "first")], "Unresolved")

meta$hgg_clusters <- droplevels(meta$hgg_clusters)
neftel_pct <- as.data.frame(round(100 * prop.table(table(hgg_clusters = meta$hgg_clusters, Neftel_call = meta$Neftel_call), margin = 1), 1))
colnames(neftel_pct) <- c("hgg_clusters", "call", "pct")
nomura_pct <- as.data.frame(round(100 * prop.table(table(hgg_clusters = meta$hgg_clusters, Nomura_call = meta$Nomura_call), margin = 1), 1))
colnames(nomura_pct) <- c("hgg_clusters", "call", "pct")

identity_colors <- c(MES = "#2a78d6", AC = "#eb6834", OPC = "#1baf7a", NPC = "#eda100", GPC = "#e87ba4",
                     NEU = "#008300", Hypoxia = "#4a3aa7", Stress = "#e34948", Cilia = "#c3c2b7", Unresolved = "#898781")

p1 <- ggplot(neftel_pct, aes(x = hgg_clusters, y = pct, fill = call)) + geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = identity_colors, name = "Identity") + labs(title = "Neftel 2019 (4 states)", x = "Cluster", y = "% of cells") + theme_thesis()
p2 <- ggplot(nomura_pct, aes(x = hgg_clusters, y = pct, fill = call)) + geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = identity_colors, name = "Identity") + labs(title = "Nomura 2025 (9 states)", x = "Cluster", y = "% of cells") + theme_thesis()

p_percell <- (p1 | p2) + plot_annotation(title = "Per-cell identity classification, cycling clusters (2, 4, 5)")
p_percell
save_thesis(p_percell, "cycling_clusters_percell_classification.png", FIG_DOUBLE)
```

## 12. Butterfly plots (malignant cell states)

```{r butterfly-prep}
meta_all <- gb_pde_hgg@meta.data
meta_all <- droplevels(meta_all[!meta_all$hgg_clusters %in% c("3", "8", "9"), ])  # non-malignant + low-confidence excluded

meta_all$SC_mes <- pmax(meta_all$Neftel_MES11, meta_all$Neftel_MES22)
meta_all$SC_npc <- pmax(meta_all$Neftel_NPC15, meta_all$Neftel_NPC26)
meta_all$SC_ac  <- meta_all$Neftel_AC3
meta_all$SC_opc <- meta_all$Neftel_OPC4

meta_all$D <- pmax(meta_all$SC_opc, meta_all$SC_npc) - pmax(meta_all$SC_ac, meta_all$SC_mes)
meta_all$Y <- sign(meta_all$D) * log2(abs(meta_all$D) + 1)
meta_all$X <- ifelse(meta_all$D > 0,
                      sign(meta_all$SC_npc - meta_all$SC_opc) * log2(abs(meta_all$SC_opc - meta_all$SC_npc) + 1),
                      sign(meta_all$SC_mes - meta_all$SC_ac)  * log2(abs(meta_all$SC_ac  - meta_all$SC_mes) + 1))

x_max <- max(meta_all$X, na.rm = TRUE); x_min <- min(meta_all$X, na.rm = TRUE)
y_max <- max(meta_all$Y, na.rm = TRUE); y_min <- min(meta_all$Y, na.rm = TRUE)

butterfly_base <- list(
  geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = 0.7),
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50"),
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50"),
  annotate("text", x = x_max * 0.95, y = y_max * 1.12, label = "NPC-like", fontface = "bold"),
  annotate("text", x = x_min * 0.95, y = y_max * 1.12, label = "OPC-like", fontface = "bold"),
  annotate("text", x = x_max * 0.95, y = y_min * 1.12, label = "MES-like", fontface = "bold"),
  annotate("text", x = x_min * 0.95, y = y_min * 1.12, label = "AC-like",  fontface = "bold"),
  coord_equal(clip = "off"),
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.20)),
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.20)),
  labs(x = "Relative score (OPC <-> NPC or AC <-> MES axis)", y = "Relative score ((OPC/NPC) vs (AC/MES))", color = "Cluster"),
  theme_thesis(), theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 60, b = 20, l = 60))
)

```

```{r butterfly-single, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5.5}
# FIGURE: ANNEX -- butterfly plot, all HGG cells pooled
p_butterfly <- ggplot(meta_all, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = hgg_clusters)) + butterfly_base +
  ggtitle("Butterfly plot: malignant cell states")
p_butterfly
save_thesis(p_butterfly, "butterfly_plot_malignant_only.png", list(w = FIG_SINGLE$w + 1, h = FIG_SINGLE$h + 1))
```

```{r butterfly-split, fig.width=11, fig.height=5.5}
# FIGURE: ANNEX -- butterfly plot, split by tissue vs PDE
meta_all$tissue_label <- ifelse(meta_all$orig.ident == "GB_tissue", "GB tissue", "PDE")
p_butterfly_split <- ggplot(meta_all, aes(x = X, y = Y, color = hgg_clusters)) + butterfly_base +
  facet_wrap(~ tissue_label) +
  ggtitle("Butterfly plot: malignant cell states, GB vs PDE") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
p_butterfly_split
save_thesis(p_butterfly_split, "butterfly_plot_GB_vs_PDE.png", list(w = FIG_WIDE$w - 2, h = FIG_SINGLE$h + 1))
```

```{r composition-calls-all}
# Neftel 4 états (MES1+MES2 -> MES, NPC1+NPC2 -> NPC), déjà groupés dans butterfly-prep (SC_mes/SC_ac/SC_opc/SC_npc) -- même logique que les axes du butterfly plot, appliquée ici à toutes les cellules malignes.
neftel_matrix_all <- as.matrix(meta_all[, c("SC_mes", "SC_ac", "SC_opc", "SC_npc")])
colnames(neftel_matrix_all) <- c("MES", "AC", "OPC", "NPC")
neftel_max_all <- apply(neftel_matrix_all, 1, max)
meta_all$Neftel_call <- ifelse(neftel_max_all > 0,
                                colnames(neftel_matrix_all)[max.col(neftel_matrix_all, ties.method = "first")],
                                "Unresolved")

# Nomura 9 états, toutes cellules malignes (réutilise les scores déjà
# calculés sur l'objet complet dans cycling-cluster-scoring).
nomura_matrix_all <- as.matrix(meta_all[, c("Nomura_MES3", "Nomura_AC2", "Nomura_OPC1", "Nomura_NPC4",
```

## 13. Feature plots (cytometry/IF marker panel)

```{r featureplot-prep}
# Color intensity is drawn from normalized RNA counts (already computed in
# Section 11), not from SCT -- standard practice: cluster/UMAP on the
# integrated SCT space, but visualize individual marker expression on
# normalized RNA so every gene (not just the SCT variable-feature set) is
# guaranteed to be available.
DefaultAssay(gb_pde_hgg) <- "RNA"

my_panel <- c("GFAP", "SOX2", "MKI67", "PECAM1", "PTPRC", "NES", "OLIG2", "EGFR")
gb_tissue <- subset(gb_pde_hgg, subset = orig.ident == "GB_tissue")
gb_pde    <- subset(gb_pde_hgg, subset = orig.ident == "PDE")

expr_data <- FetchData(gb_pde_hgg, vars = my_panel)
gene_max  <- apply(expr_data, 2, max)

# Fixing color-scale limits per gene (instead of letting each panel
# auto-scale) avoids an all-zero gene rendering as flat mid-blue/orange.
#
# `cols` is a parameter (default grey90 -> blue) so the same function can
# render the PDE panel in a different color from the GB tissue panel below,
# so PDE is visually distinguishable from tissue at a glance.
make_panel <- function(obj, g, cols = c("grey90", "#2a78d6")) {
  FeaturePlot(obj, features = g, reduction = "umap.integrated", order = TRUE,
              cols = cols, min.cutoff = 0, max.cutoff = gene_max[g]) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = cols, limits = c(0, gene_max[g])) +
    theme_thesis() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
 
      plot.title = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold", hjust = 0),

      legend.text = element_text(size = 13)
    )
}
```

## 14. Figure 4.11 -- GB tissue vs PDE genome-wide concordance (malignant-only, patient-matched)


```{r fig411-patient-matching-helpers}
hgg_clusters_gb_patient1 <- c("1")  # patient_1 seulement, exclut patient_2_tissue_only

# Pools several clusters' mean_gene_profile into one condition-level profile,
# weighted by each cluster's cell count.
pool_condition_profile <- function(profiles, clusters) {
  mats <- lapply(clusters, function(cl) profiles[[cl]]$mean_gene_profile)
  common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(mats, names))
  mats <- lapply(mats, function(m) m[common_genes])
  weights <- sapply(clusters, function(cl) profiles[[cl]]$n_cells)
  Reduce(`+`, Map(function(m, w) m * w, mats, weights)) / sum(weights)
}

# Collapses a per-gene profile down to one mean signal value per chromosome.
chr_profile_by_condition <- function(gene_profile, gene_order) {
  common <- intersect(names(gene_profile), rownames(gene_order))
  data.frame(gene = common, chr = gene_order[common, "chr"], signal = gene_profile[common]) %>%
    group_by(chr) %>% summarise(mean_signal = mean(signal), .groups = "drop")
}
```

```{r fig411-infercnv-runner-malignant}
## Malignant-only version of the per-genetic-cluster inferCNV runner.
## Identical to run_infercnv_shared_reference(), except cells_this_cluster is additionally intersected with a malignant-cell barcode list before the inferCNV run -- so non-malignant, non-myeloid cells (oligodendrocyte-like, stromal, endothelial, neuronal-like) sharing the patient's genotype are excluded too, not just the shared myeloid reference.

run_infercnv_shared_reference_malignant <- function(seurat_obj, combined_obj, pool_label,
                                                      cluster_col = "souporcell_cluster",
                                                      fixed_ref_cells, gene_order_file,
                                                      restrict_to,   # malignant cell barcodes
                                                      out_dir_base = "infercnv_by_genetic_cluster_malignant",
                                                      min_ref_cells = 30, n_threads = 4, clusters_subset = NULL) {

  dir.create(out_dir_base, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data
  stopifnot(cluster_col %in% colnames(meta))

  clusters <- sort(unique(na.omit(meta[[cluster_col]])))
  if (!is.null(clusters_subset)) clusters <- clusters[clusters %in% clusters_subset]

  ref_cells <- fixed_ref_cells
  if (length(ref_cells) < min_ref_cells) stop("Shared reference has fewer than min_ref_cells -- check filtering.")

  results <- list()
  for (cl in clusters) {
    cells_this_cluster <- rownames(meta)[meta[[cluster_col]] == cl]
    cells_this_cluster <- intersect(cells_this_cluster, restrict_to)   # <-- the only change vs. the original
    n_cells <- length(cells_this_cluster)
    message(sprintf("[%s] cluster %s: %d malignant-only cells", pool_label, cl, n_cells))
    if (n_cells < 50) warning(sprintf("[%s] cluster %s: only %d cells (<50)", pool_label, cl, n_cells))

    test_cells <- setdiff(cells_this_cluster, ref_cells)
    obj_sub <- subset(combined_obj, cells = c(test_cells, ref_cells))
    obj_sub <- tryCatch(JoinLayers(obj_sub), error = function(e) obj_sub)
    counts  <- GetAssayData(obj_sub, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

    annot <- data.frame(
      group = ifelse(colnames(obj_sub) %in% ref_cells, "reference", paste0(pool_label, "_cluster", cl)),
      row.names = colnames(obj_sub)
    )
    annot_file <- file.path(out_dir_base, sprintf("annot_%s_cluster%s.txt", pool_label, cl))
    write.table(annot, annot_file, sep = "\t", col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

    out_dir <- file.path(out_dir_base, sprintf("%s_cluster%s", pool_label, cl))
    dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    infercnv_obj <- CreateInfercnvObject(raw_counts_matrix = counts, annotations_file = annot_file,
                                          gene_order_file = gene_order_file, ref_group_names = "reference")
    infercnv_obj <- infercnv::run(infercnv_obj, cutoff = 0.1, out_dir = out_dir, cluster_by_groups = TRUE,
                                   denoise = TRUE, HMM = FALSE, num_threads = n_threads)

    results[[as.character(cl)]] <- list(n_cells = n_cells, out_dir = out_dir, status = "done")
    rm(obj_sub, counts, infercnv_obj, annot)
    gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }
  results
}

## Malignant cell barcodes, same definition as panel B's malignant_cells
malignant_cells_all <- colnames(gb_pde_hgg)[!(gb_pde_hgg$hgg_clusters %in% c("3", "8", "9"))]

## Sanity check before running inferCNV -- if either count is ~0, the
## barcodes don't match between gb_pde_hgg and gb_diet/pde_diet (e.g. a

        length(intersect(rownames(gb_diet@meta.data)[gb_diet$souporcell_cluster %in% hgg_clusters_gb_patient1],

        length(intersect(rownames(pde_diet@meta.data)[pde_diet$souporcell_cluster %in% hgg_clusters_pde_v2],
                          malignant_cells_all)))
```

## 15. Per-chromosome, per-cell CNV distribution (Annexe -- amplitude-gap explanation)

Follows up on Figure 4.11 panel A: although the genome-wide CNV profile
correlates well between GB tissue and PDE (same altered chromosomes), their
signal AMPLITUDE differs on several of them. This section looks at the
per-cell, per-chromosome score distributions (not averaged across
chromosomes, unlike panel A) to see whether that gap is specific to the
chromosomes already known to be altered, or generic across the genome --
this is the figure referenced in Results as the Annexe support for the
culture-enrichment hypothesis.

```{r fig-annexe-percell-bychr}
library(tidyr)

## Score par cellule ET par chromosome (pas de moyenne genome-wide,
## pas restreint a chr7/10) -- une colonne par chromosome, une ligne par cellule.
read_infercnv_percell_bychr <- function(out_dir, gene_order) {
  obj_file <- file.path(out_dir, "run.final.infercnv_obj")
  if (!file.exists(obj_file)) { warning(sprintf("Can't find %s", obj_file)); return(NULL) }
  infercnv_obj <- readRDS(obj_file)

  full_mat <- infercnv_obj@expr.data
  obs_idx  <- unlist(infercnv_obj@observation_grouped_cell_indices)
  obs      <- full_mat[, obs_idx, drop = FALSE]

  common_genes <- intersect(rownames(obs), rownames(gene_order))
  obs   <- obs[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
  chrom <- gene_order[common_genes, "chr"]

  chr_num_vals <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", as.character(chrom)))
  keep <- !is.na(chr_num_vals) & chr_num_vals %in% 1:22
  obs <- obs[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  chr_label <- paste0("chr", chr_num_vals[keep])
  chr_levels <- paste0("chr", sort(unique(chr_num_vals[keep])))

  mat <- sapply(chr_levels, function(ch) {
    genes_this_chr <- rownames(obs)[chr_label == ch]
    if (length(genes_this_chr) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(obs)))
    colMeans(obs[genes_this_chr, , drop = FALSE])
  })
  colnames(mat) <- chr_levels
  rownames(mat) <- colnames(obs)
  as.data.frame(mat)
}

extract_percell_bychr <- function(res, pool_label, gene_order) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res), function(cl) {
    if (!identical(res[[cl]]$status, "done")) return(NULL)
    df <- read_infercnv_percell_bychr(res[[cl]]$out_dir, gene_order)
    if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
    df$cell_id   <- rownames(df)
    df$cluster   <- cl
    df$condition <- pool_label
    df
  }))
}

bychr_gb       <- extract_percell_bychr(res_gb_v2_malignant,  "GB",  gene_order)
bychr_pde      <- extract_percell_bychr(res_pde_v2_malignant, "PDE", gene_order)
bychr_combined <- rbind(bychr_gb, bychr_pde)

bychr_long <- bychr_combined %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("chr"), names_to = "chr", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = paste0("chr", 1:22)))

p_bychr_dist <- ggplot(bychr_long, aes(x = score, fill = condition, color = condition)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ chr, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("GB" = "#2C7FB8", "PDE" = "#D95F02")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("GB" = "#2C7FB8", "PDE" = "#D95F02")) +
  labs(title = "Per-cell CNV signal by chromosome (malignant-only)",
       x = "Mean signal (per cell)", y = "Density", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_thesis(base_size = 10)

p_bychr_dist
save_thesis(p_bychr_dist, "figure_percell_bychr_distribution_malignant.png", list(w = 14, h = 16))
```
